subject.title: fix(agents): treat unterminated Responses SSE stream as error, not success

question: Which open implementation should own the fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/108958 before either contributor adds the remaining live transport proof?
rationale: Both PRs now cover the core terminal-event invariant, but they differ in error placement and test architecture; selecting one canonical branch avoids duplicated or conflicting fixes.

options.title: Prefer direct transport throw
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 as the canonical candidate because it throws at the parser boundary and reuses the existing stream harness, then require live interruption proof before merge.

options.title: Retain this state-machine patch
options.body: Keep this PR as canonical, refactor duplicated terminal-response accounting if needed, and require the same live interruption and upgrade proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Prefer direct transport throw
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/109133 as the canonical candidate because it throws at the parser boundary and reuses the existing stream harness, then require live interruption proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Historical ownership of the predecessor Responses stream parser makes this the strongest available routing signal for choosing the terminal-event design.
